about: Film (output) time u -> song time s. Identity: the extended recording (media/audio/Orbital_Sunrise_alt2.mp3, the re-record) plays its own ritardando, so the picture needs no slowdown (the released cut's was tools/ritardando.py's, see git history). Kept so render.mjs and the page find the audio; a map in the same format ([[s, u], ...], identity before its first point, a constant shift after its last) would slow the picture again.
